sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your message.

Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 45.80 per unit (cost:part:PH-100).
Our last three orders for this part were at EUR 48.60, EUR 47.40 and EUR 48.60 (po:4500001201, po:4500001288, po:4500001342).
Your letter (doc:D01-LETTER) gives less notice than our framework agreement provides for (ctr:D01-FRAMEWORK).

Please find our proposal in the term sheet(s) attached to this e-mail.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €50.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
You are correct regarding the notice period in our framework agreement; as we always honor our commitments, we have adjusted the effective date to 1 February 2027.
We appreciate your proposal for a 24-month contract term, which offers valuable planning security for our foundry.
In exchange for this longer commitment, we are prepared to lower our offer to €50.00 per unit.
Alternatively, with valid from 1 February 2027: €50.00 per unit.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €49.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
In response to your movement, we are prepared to take a further step and offer €49.20 per unit.
We maintain the 24-month contract and 30-day payment terms, and look forward to reaching an agreement that reflects our long-standing partnership.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €48.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We have taken every possible step towards you, making €48.50 per unit our final offer.
We trust that we can now conclude this negotiation and continue our long-standing partnership.
We have supplied you reliably for years and expect fairness in return.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
